displayPattern: Shown on the control board 7-segment display: EE0
meaning: Furnace lockout after too many ignition retries (3 total): flame failed to establish or was lost after establishment.
causes: Front cover pressure switch or condensate drainage problem
Blocked or improperly sized flue piping
diySteps: Confirm the gas supply to the furnace is on and not interrupted
Check that the outdoor vent and intake terminations are not blocked
Technician: check front cover pressure switch operation and drainage (hose, wiring, contacts)
Technician: replace or realign the igniter
Technician: check flame sense signal and clean the sensor if coated or oxidized
Technician: verify flue piping length, elbows and termination, and induced draft blower performance
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if the furnace locks out again after the gas supply and vent terminations are confirmed clear.
